title: Applications for Notifications for Relief under COVID-19 (Temporary Measures) Act
what_it_is: Applications for Notifications for Relief under COVID-19 (Temporary Measures) Act

sections.label: Notifications for Relief served online
sections.summary: As at 29 May 2020, 3,943 Notifications for Relief were served online, and hardcopy NFRs cannot be tracked.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: As at 29 May 2020, which is around five weeks since the Act commenced, 3,943 Notifications for Relief (NFRs) have been served using the online system.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: Parties may also serve the NFRs in hardcopy on the counter-contracting parties.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: We are unable to track the number of hardcopy NFRs which parties served to the counter-party.

sections.label: NFRs by contract category
sections.summary: As at 29 May 2020, NFRs by contract category included 2,107 hire-purchase, 1,254 non-residential leases, 250 events, 213 construction and 97 SME loans.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: The number of NFRs served as at 29 May 2020 for each category of contract is as follows: (a) Hire-purchase and conditional sale agreements: 2,107 (b) Leases or licences of non-residential properties: 1,254 (c) Events and tourism-related contracts: 250 (d) Construction contracts and supply contracts: 213 (e) Certain secured loans to SMEs: 97 (f) Options to purchase given by housing developers, or sales and purchase agreements between purchasers and housing developers for housing accommodation, which were only added to the scheduled contracts – Members may wish to note – on 13 May 2020.

sections.label: Notice of intention supplementary Bill
sections.summary: A notice of intention to put in a supplementary to the Bill was filed yesterday, with steps to raise public awareness and education.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: The Member may know that we have yesterday filed a notice of intention to put in a supplementary to the Bill.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: This relates to other aspects of the Bill.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: But no doubt, together with that, we will step up steps to raise consciousness and public awareness and also public education on the operation of both aspects of the (Temporary Measures) Bill.
